tiers.CORE: Normalize when present; on FULL90 observed source must be read. Schema remains nullable for missing/conflicting variants and other PDFs.
tiers.TARGETED: Always preserve source text/evidence; emit a separate fact only for an assigned criterion/function. Do not add typed profile columns by default.

consumer_policy.documents: Only source-supported values; do not read generator metadata or expected QA as extractor input.
consumer_policy.scope_temporal: Use C02 plus pinned knowledge; unavailable classification/date stays UNKNOWN with reason.
consumer_policy.retrieval: Use original chunks and C05; do not require every clause to be pre-extracted as a scalar fact.
consumer_policy.compliance: P4 binds facts/units/predicate and independently verifies. Missing evidence does not remove a requirement from the checklist.
consumer_policy.risk_recommendation: Consume C07/C08/C09 and provenance, not pre-labelled risks from the PDF.
consumer_policy.report: Show the actual run profile/results and unresolved source limitations.

source_corpus_baseline.fixed_source_constraint: No new clauses, assumptions, annexes or receipts are required to make the present corpus satisfy extra legal fields. Preserve source; report unavailable facts under the applicable policy.
acceptance_requirements_not_run_results: Read CORE from its real source on independently annotated DEV/VAL examples.
Preserve TARGETED source text; do not treat absence of optional structured facts as missing PDF content.
Preserve missing/conflicting inputs and attribution; never invent dates/booleans/labels.
Do not parse a law issue day as warranty months or a sample form as actual performance.
Source legal scope and legal checklist remain independent of whether a retrieval match was found.
